Green Lantern Corps

Graf Toren

A Karaxian member of the Lost Lanterns.

Graf Toren is a Green Lantern from Karax whose career includes captivity and recovery. His history is a useful thread through the stories known as the Lost Lanterns.

Continuity: Main DC comics continuity; this profile follows the cited era rather than asserting a permanent present-day status.

Affiliation
Green Lantern Corps
First appearance
Guy Gardner #11 (August 1993)
Story history — History and later developments — spoilers

Graf first appears in Guy Gardner #11 as a prisoner of the Draal and helps with an escape. He later opposes Hal Jordan during Emerald Twilight and is presumed dead. Revenge of the Green Lanterns reveals that he and other missing Lanterns survived in Manhunter captivity. Their rescue is a reversal of the earlier presumed fate, not evidence that his first defeat never happened.

Key Stories

  • Revenge of the Green Lanterns
    Green Lantern (2005) #7–13 (2006)
